draft_key_information_units.information: The Group reported revenue of EUR 29.8 million for the three months ended 31 March 2026, increasing from EUR 25.3 million in the same period of 2025. The Company reported revenue of EUR 28.7 million, up from EUR 24.3 million. Group net profit rose to EUR 7.2 million from EUR 4.4 million; Company net profit increased to EUR 6.8 million from EUR 4.0 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income (page 4)

draft_key_information_units.information: The LNG terminal (LNGT) segment generated revenue of EUR 18.7 million in Q1 2026, a 25% increase compared with EUR 14.9 million in Q1 2025.
The liquid energy terminals (LET) segment revenue decreased to EUR 7.8 million for the period ended 31 March 2026 from EUR 7.9 million in the comparable period of 2025.

Commercial LNG (comLNG) segment revenue grew to EUR 3.4 million for Q1 2026 from EUR 2.5 million in Q1 2025, supported by activities of subsidiaries in Brazil (KN Açu Servicos de Terminal de GNL LTDA) and Germany (KN Energies Deutschland GmbH).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Operating Segments analysis, Note 4 (page 8) and General Information, Note 1.2 (page 7)

draft_key_information_units.information: Operating activities generated cash flows of EUR 27.9 million in Q1 2026, more than double the EUR 13.8 million recorded in the prior-year period.
Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 17.99 million as at 31 March 2026 from EUR 12.36 million as at 31 December 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statements of Cash Flow and Statements of Financial Position (pages 6 and 3)

draft_key_information_units.information: Total borrowings stood at EUR 302.1 million as at 31 March 2026, down slightly from EUR 311.2 million as at 31 December 2025; lease liabilities were EUR 24.6 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Borrowings and Lease Liabilities note, Note 9 (page 11)

draft_key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the reporting period, on 30 April 2026 the Company elected a new independent Board, replacing the previous two-tier governance structure with a unitary Board governance model.
Group EBITDA increased to EUR 16.2 million for Q1 2026 from EUR 13.6 million in Q1 2025.

evaluation.selection_rationale: The draft units capture material summary-level information directly supported by the source report: headline revenue and profit performance (D1), major segment developments including LNGT growth, LET decline, and comLNG expansion with international subsidiaries (D2-D4), strong cash generation and liquidity position (D5-D6), financing structure (D7), and a significant post-period governance change (D8). EBITDA is included as a key performance metric emphasized in the reference summary (D9). Units are independently omittable themes aligning with prioritized areas (financial performance, segment developments, liquidity, strategic changes). Routine boilerplate (governance details beyond the material change, remuneration, accounting policies) is excluded. All figures and facts are source-verified, with no invented drivers or causal relationships.
